Baaz kehte hain anjeer murad hai, zaitoon se koi kehta hai Masjid-e-Bait-ul-Muqaddas murad hai. Kisi ne kaha ke woh zaitoon jise nichorte ho, Toor-e-Sineen woh pahar hai jis par Hazrat Musa A.S se Allah Ta'ala ne kalam kiya tha, Balad-ul-Ameen se murad Makkah Sharif hai is mein kisi ko ikhtilaf nahin. Baaz ka qaul yeh hai ke yeh teeno woh jaghein hain jahan teen Ulul-Azm sahib-e-shariat paighambar bheje gaye thay, teen se murad toh Bait-ul-Muqaddas hai jahan par Hazrat Isa A.S ko nabi bana kar bheja gaya tha aur Toor-e-Sineen se murad Toor-e-Sina hai jahan Hazrat Musa bin Imran A.S se Allah Ta'ala ne kalam kiya tha aur Balad-e-Ameen se murad Makkah Mukarramah jahan hamare sardar Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ bheje gaye, Taurat ke aakhir mein bhi in teeno jaghon ka naam hai is mein hai ke Toor-e-Sina se Allah Ta'ala aaya yani wahan par Hazrat Isa A.S ko wahan bheja aur Faran ki chotiyon par woh buland hua yani Makkah ke paharon se Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ko bheja, phir in teeno zabardast bare martabe wale paighambaron ki zamani aur wujoodi tarteeb bayan kar di. Isi tarah yahan bhi pehle jis ka naam liya us se zyada shareef cheez ka naam phir liya aur phir in dono se buzurg-tar cheez ka naam aakhir mein liya. Phir in qasmon ke baad bayan farmaya ke insaan ko achi shakal-o-surat mein sahi qad-o-qamat wala, durust aur sadol aaza wala khubsurat aur suhane chehre wala paida kiya, phir use neeche ka neecha kar diya yani jahannami ho gaya, agar Allah ki itaat aur Rasool ki itteba na ki toh, isi liye imaan walon ko is se alag kar liya, baaz kehte hain ke murad intehai burhape ki taraf lota dena hai. Hazrat Ikrama R.H farmate hain jis ne Quran jama kiya woh razeel umar ko na pohanche ga, Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H isi ko pasand farmate hain lekin agar yahi burhapa murad hota toh mominon ka istisna kyun hota? Burhapa toh baaz mominon par bhi aata hai, pas theek baat wahi hai jo oopar hum ne zikr ki jaise aur jagah Surah Al-Asr mein hai ke tamam insaan nuqsan mein hain siwaye imaan aur aamal-e-saleh walon ke ke unhein aisi nek jaza milegi jis ki inteha na ho jaise pehle bayan ho chuka hai, phir farmata hai ae insaan jabke tu apni pehli aur awwal martaba ki paidaish ko jaanta hai toh phir jaza-o-saza ke din ke aane par aur tere dobara zinda hone par tujhe kyun yaqeen nahin? Kya wajah hai ke tu ise nahin maanta halanke zahir hai ke jis ne pehli dafa paida kar diya us par dusri dafa ka paida karna kya mushkil hai? Hazrat Mujahid R.H ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se pooch baithe ke is se murad Aan-Hazrat ﷺ hain? Aap ne farmaya Ma'azAllah is se murad mutlaq insaan hai, Ikrama R.H waghera ka bhi yahi qaul hai.

Kya wajah hai ke tu ise nahin maanta halanke zahir hai ke jis ne pehli dafa paida kar diya us par dusri dafa ka paida karna kya mushkil hai? Hazrat Mujahid R.H ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se pooch baithe ke is se murad Aan-Hazrat ﷺ hain? Aap ne farmaya Ma'azAllah is se murad mutlaq insaan hai, Ikrama R.H waghera ka bhi yahi qaul hai.

Phir farmata hai ke kya Allah Hakam-ul-Hakimin nahin hai? Woh na zulm kare na be-adli kare, isi liye woh Qayamat qaim karega aur har ek zalim se mazloom ka inteqam lega. Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se marfoo hadith mein yeh guzar chuka hai ke jo shakhs "Wat-teen-i-waz-zaitoon" (Surah At-Teen) padhe aur uske aakhir ki aayat "Alaisal-lahu" padhe to keh de "Bala wa ana ala zalika minash-shahidin" yani haan aur main is par gawah hoon. Allah ke fazl-o-karam se Surah At-Teen ki tafsir khatam hui, Falhamdulillah.

Teen se murad kisi ke nazdeek toh Masjid-e-Damishq hai, koi kehta hai khud Damishq murad hai, kisi ke nazdeek Damishq ka ek pahar murad hai, baaz kehte hain ke Ashab-e-Kahf ki masjid murad hai, koi kehta hai ke Judi pahar par Masjid-e-Nooh hai woh murad hai. Baaz kehte hain anjeer murad hai, zaitoon se koi kehta hai Masjid-e-Bait-ul-Muqaddas murad hai. Kisi ne kaha ke woh zaitoon jise nichorte ho, Toor-e-Sineen woh pahar hai jis par Hazrat Musa A.S se Allah Ta'ala ne kalam kiya tha, Balad-ul-Ameen se murad Makkah Sharif hai is mein kisi ko ikhtilaf nahin. Baaz ka qaul yeh hai ke yeh teeno woh jaghein hain jahan teen Ulul-Azm sahib-e-shariat paighambar bheje gaye thay, teen se murad toh Bait-ul-Muqaddas hai jahan par Hazrat Isa A.S ko nabi bana kar bheja gaya tha aur Toor-e-Sineen se murad Toor-e-Sina hai jahan Hazrat Musa bin Imran A.S se Allah Ta'ala ne kalam kiya tha aur Balad-e-Ameen se murad Makkah Mukarramah jahan hamare sardar Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ bheje gaye, Taurat ke aakhir mein bhi in teeno jaghon ka naam hai is mein hai ke Toor-e-Sina se Allah Ta'ala aaya yani wahan par Hazrat Isa A.S ko wahan bheja aur Faran ki chotiyon par woh buland hua yani Makkah ke paharon se Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ko bheja, phir in teeno zabardast bare martabe wale paighambaron ki zamani aur wujoodi tarteeb bayan kar di. Isi tarah yahan bhi pehle jis ka naam liya us se zyada shareef cheez ka naam phir liya aur phir in dono se buzurg-tar cheez ka naam aakhir mein liya. Phir in qasmon ke baad bayan farmaya ke insaan ko achi shakal-o-surat mein sahi qad-o-qamat wala, durust aur sadol aaza wala khubsurat aur suhane chehre wala paida kiya, phir use neeche ka neecha kar diya yani jahannami ho gaya, agar Allah ki itaat aur Rasool ki itteba na ki toh, isi liye imaan walon ko is se alag kar liya, baaz kehte hain ke murad intehai burhape ki taraf lota dena hai.
